AOI 01: EF Technology Sprints - Activated Digital Thread for Battlefield Responsiveness AFRL is seeking innovative solutions to operationalize digital architecture capable of responding to battlefield dynamics in near real-time. The objective is to close the loop between battlefield data and the manufacturing floor, creating an adaptive manufacturing ecosystem that expedites the re-configuration of weapon systems to enhance warfighter lethality. Solutions are sought to drastically reduce design-to-field cycle times by addressing one or more of the following technical challenges: (1) Model-Based Quality Assurance & Digital Certification. Goal: Transition from physical-test-dependent to analysis-led certification. To realize surge manufacturing, the bottleneck of physical requalification for every design change must be eliminated. Solutions are sought that leverage Certification by Analysis (CbA) and probabilistic simulation to validate manufacturing variability and design changes. Approaches should address how seamless data interchange can support certification allowing for rapid acceptance of re-configured components without extensive physical testing campaigns. (2) Modular Integration & Factorial Manufacturing. Goal: Enable "Plug-and-Play"
